sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; ScopeJudge ranked first and exact duplicate checks found no local hit.
Read arXiv abstract, HTML, and PDF; extracted dataset, formulas, algorithm, tables, results, limitations, and operating points.
Checked arXiv search results and third-party discussion pages; no stronger current-week duplicate source was found.
Article uses Markdown tables, formula blocks, pseudocode, and Mermaid; images were not localized because figures were reproducible text evidence.
